en: God's wrath is revealed against each of us.

text:
진리를 억누르는 사람들에게
하나님의 진노가 뭡니까?
en: For those who suppress the truth, what is God's wrath?
Doing what they want.
That is God's wrath.
God's judgment on godlessness and wickedness
is letting us have what we want.
What if, from childhood until now,
your parents had never once told you no?
Your life would be headed for ruin.

text:
원하는 대로 하도록
나보다 더 *사랑*하는 사람들이
en: If those who love me more than I love myself
hadn't stopped me from doing as I pleased,
I'd have ended up in ruin.

text:
그러나 인간은 하나님이
마음의 *중심*에 계실 때
en: But we were made to find, with God at the center of our hearts,

text:
참된 만족과 의미를
누리도록 창조되었기 때문에
en: true satisfaction and meaning,
so even getting what we want doesn't satisfy.
Not having it is hard,

text:
가져도 내가 원하는 그것이
거기에 있지는 않습니다
en: and once you have it, what you wanted isn't there.
Oscar Wilde said,
"When the gods wish to punish us,
they answer our prayers."
So the saying goes.
Getting what I want
is not a blessing.
What I want has to change.
